attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow validates. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ktg_001
steps:
  - id: receive_intake_form
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: trigger.intake_form
      fields:
        - claimant_first_name
        - claimant_last_name
        - date_of_injury
        - employer
        - ssn
        - client_database
        - submitted_by
    output: intake_data

  - id: authenticate_staff_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      token: "{{trigger.auth_token}}"
      role_required: case_staff
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_claimant_fields
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{intake_data}}"
      required_fields:
        - claimant_first_name
        - claimant_last_name
        - date_of_injury
        - employer
        - ssn
        - client_database
    on_failure: error_handler

  - id: tenant_branch_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: tenant_field_selection
      condition: "{{intake_data.client_database}}"
      branches:
        tenant_a:
          field_list: tenant_a_fields
        tenant_b:
          field_list: tenant_b_fields
        default:
          field_list: default_fields
    output: tenant_config

  - id: compute_next_claimant_id
    op: read_database
    params:
      query: "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(claimant_id), 0) + 1 AS next_id FROM claimants"
      connection: "{{intake_data.client_database}}"
    output: next_claimant_id

  - id: insert_claimant_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: claimants
      connection: "{{intake_data.client_database}}"
      operation: insert
      record:
        claimant_id: "{{next_claimant_id.next_id}}"
        first_name: "{{intake_data.claimant_first_name}}"
        last_name: "{{intake_data.claimant_last_name}}"
        date_of_injury: "{{intake_data.date_of_injury}}"
        employer: "{{intake_data.employer}}"
        ssn: "{{intake_data.ssn}}"
        field_list: "{{tenant_config.field_list}}"
    output: claimant_record

  - id: insert_wc_case_stub
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: workers_comp_cases
      connection: "{{intake_data.client_database}}"
      operation: insert
      record:
        claimant_id: "{{next_claimant_id.next_id}}"
        case_status: new
        date_opened: "{{now()}}"
    output: wc_case_record

  - id: insert_icd_placeholders
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: icd_codes
      connection: "{{intake_data.client_database}}"
      operation: insert
      record:
        claimant_id: "{{next_claimant_id.next_id}}"
        case_id: "{{wc_case_record.case_id}}"
        icd_code: PENDING
        status: placeholder
    output: icd_record

  - id: insert_rtw_placeholders
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: return_to_work
      connection: "{{intake_data.client_database}}"
      operation: insert
      record:
        claimant_id: "{{next_claimant_id.next_id}}"
        case_id: "{{wc_case_record.case_id}}"
        rtw_status: pending
        status: placeholder
    output: rtw_record

  - id: log_activity_and_tickler
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: New Patient Set Up
      claimant_id: "{{next_claimant_id.next_id}}"
      case_id: "{{wc_case_record.case_id}}"
      performed_by: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
    output: audit_log

  - id: insert_default_tickler
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: ticklers
      connection: "{{intake_data.client_database}}"
      operation: insert
      record:
        claimant_id: "{{next_claimant_id.next_id}}"
        case_id: "{{wc_case_record.case_id}}"
        tickler_type: default_followup
        due_date: "{{date_add(now(), 30, 'days')}}"
        assigned_to: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
        status: open
    output: tickler_record

  - id: error_handler
    op: handle_error
    params:
      strategy: notify_and_terminate
      on_error_steps:
        - id: format_error_dump
          op: format_output
          params:
            template: full_form_dump
            data: "{{intake_data}}"
            error: "{{error}}"
          output: error_dump
        - id: email_error_to_staff
          op: notify_user
          params:
            method: email
            to: internal_staff_distribution
            subject: "Claimant Intake Failure - {{intake_data.claimant_last_name}}"
            body: "{{error_dump}}"
